t.E301.agn: In 2015 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E301.body: In the body it behaves as ascorbic acid (vitamin C); any excess is excreted in the urine.
t.E301.prod: Obtained by neutralising vitamin C (ascorbic acid) with sodium bicarbonate; ascorbic acid is produced from glucose by fermentation and chemical steps.
t.E301.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern.
t.E301.summary: The sodium salt of vitamin C. It helps preserve colour in meat products and is used as an antioxidant.
t.E301.what: It is the sodium salt of vitamin C; it slows oxidation and helps preserve colour in processed meats.
